title: Home
text:
Control engineer · Researcher · Educator




I work on nonlinear and networked control systems, with a focus on multi-agent systems, string stability, and modern control education.

I am based at the Queensland University of Technology and enjoy building research that connects theory, implementation, and teaching practice.

Contact me View résumé

title: Home
text:
Research highlights




Vehicle platooning
Disturbance string stable control design for vehicle platoons with actuator dynamics and external disturbances.





Inverter-based microgrids
Controller design for chains of frequency-controlled inverters with guaranteed string-stability properties.





Shadow compensation
Automatic detection and removal of shadows in urban aerial imagery for near-real-time applications.

title: Home
text:
Focus areas


Control design
Nonlinear control, multi-agent coordination, and string stability.

Academic publications spanning control theory, applications, and engineering systems.


Teaching
Lecturing, tutoring, and curriculum development across modern control and autonomous systems.
